P1.1.text: Innovation Driven by Engineering Excellence | Crane Co.

P1.2.text: Crane Co. delivers engineered solutions for aerospace, defense, flow technologies, and critical industries—driven by innovation and 170 years of excellence.

P1.4.text: Our businesses are driven by proprietary and differentiated technology, proven reliability, deep vertical expertise, and responsiveness to unique customer needs.

P1.5.text: Redefining What’s Possible in Mission-Critical Innovation.

P1.6.text: We push the boundaries of innovation, delivering proprietary solutions that set new standards for mission-critical performance across aerospace, defense, and other demanding environments.

P1.7.text: Engineering Excellence Built for Mission-Critical Challenges.

P1.8.text: We deliver highly engineered, proprietary solutions that ensure reliability in mission-critical applications across the harshest environments—from cryogenics and nuclear to pharmaceutical, chemical, and water.

P1.10.text: Crane has always been an engineering led company. As our organization continues to mature, we are continuing to refine our approach to innovation and new product development.

P1.11.text: “I am resolved to conduct my business in the strictest honesty and fairness; to avoid all deception and trickery; to deal fairly with both customers and competitors; to be liberal and just toward employees; and to put my whole mind upon the business.”

P1.12.text: Richard Teller Crane, Founder of Crane Co.

P1.13.text: Our strategy is built for durability, innovation, and long-term success.

P1.14.text: We believe that attracting and retaining the highest quality people is the best insurance of success.

P2.1.text: Crane Co. Process Flow Technologies | Valves, Pumps & Controls

P2.2.text: Crane Co. delivers process flow technologies for chemical, energy, water, nuclear, and industrial markets, including valves, pumps, instrumentation, and controls.

P2.3.text: Crane’s Process Flow Technologies segment is a global provider of highly engineered products and systems, including sensing, instrumentation, controls, and flow control products. With more than 170 years of engineering excellence and expertise, Crane literally wrote the book on flow control with the introduction of the Flow of Fluids Handbook (TP410) that is still used as a definitive source in the industry.

P2.4.text: Today, with proprietary technology, precision engineering, and material science innovation, we are solving our customers’ toughest challenges in mission-critical applications that require high-reliability in many of the harshest and most hazardous environments such as cryogenics, nuclear, pharmaceutical, chemical and petrochemical, and wastewater.

P2.5.text: Crane ChemPharma & Energy designs and manufactures a variety of high-performance products for the regulation and control of fluids and gases. Its trusted brands offer customers a complete and innovative product portfolio designed for the most demanding corrosive, erosive, and high purity applications.

P2.6.text: Primary industries served include cryogenics, pharmaceuticals and biotechnology, chemical and petrochemical processing, and power generation. As an integrated fluid handling solutions provider, Crane ChemPharma & Energy is well equipped to respond to complex global projects with comprehensive product packages and timely proposals to simplify our customers’ supply chain on a local level worldwide.

P2.7.text: Crane Pumps & Systems designs and manufactures innovative pump solutions for the effective and efficient transportation of wastewater. The business is focused on solving complex customer challenges, whether helping drive efficiency with designs that reduce expensive clogging and decrease energy usage, or to improve operational performance across an aging infrastructure. Its technical specialists can provide the expertise needed to accurately evaluate service conditions and specify the most effective pumping solutions, and that commitment to excellence is carried through to the manufacturing, sales, distribution and service components of the business.

P2.8.text: Crane Nuclear is a premier provider of sensors, diagnostic flow control diagnostic and calibration equipment, on-site services, and certified “N-stamp” valves for the global nuclear power market.
